paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant geometric distance determinations
notes: Observational constraint from stellar cooling in red-giant branch (TRGB) stars. Bound derived from observed TRGB brightness compared to theoretical predictions with and without axion-electron coupling energy losses. Primary reference: NGC 4258 galaxy observations (Table 1). Mass-independent limit applicable to axion masses << stellar core temperature (~keV). Represents flat exclusion over wide mass range. See Table 1 and Section IV.D for details. Central result: g_ae < 1.6 × 10^-11 at 95% CL from NGC 4258.
